description.value: A fully serviced, 80-site RV park with a 9-hole golf course and swimming pond at the foot of the Rockies near Jaffray on Hwy 3/93; primarily oriented toward RV owners and long-term renters, with overnight stays at $65/night for 30-amp power — no tent-only rate is listed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and provides detailed campground information across multiple subpages. The OSM name 'Will-O-Bend RV Park' differs from the website's primary branding 'Willobend Golf & RV'; the OSM name is retained per rules and flagged in concerns. The campground and about pages explicitly confirm amenities including drinking water, shower house, laundry mat, event gazebo, on-site licensed restaurant, and overnight reservation phone number; the physical address on the website (2370 Highway 3/93, Jaffray, BC) corresponds to the OSM value (Crowsnest Highway = Highway 3/93), with the website version being more complete.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Will-O-Bend RV Park' but the website's primary branding is 'Willobend Golf & RV'; OSM name retained per rules.

No phone number present in OSM; top-level phone populated from website's overnight camping reservations line (250-429-4059). Multiple other numbers exist on-site (RV Sales: 250-420-7345; Golf/Restaurant: 250-429-3377).
OSM address omits city name; website physical address '2370 Highway 3/93, Jaffray, BC' used as more complete version — same road as OSM 'Crowsnest Highway' (Highway 3/93).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-documented campground on the Crowsnest Highway with confirmed overnight camping, hot showers, laundry, potable water, and on-site food — a practical and useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on this corridor.
